coordinates: mm, board seen from the top as on the drawing. x runs along the long edge from the microSD end; y runs from the near edge (micro USB, HDMI, audio), which faces the lid hinge. z is height above the top surface of the PCB.

depth_below.source: not on the drawing; microSD socket with card and through-hole pins estimated at 3 mm below the PCB

notes: No 2B drawing is published. The 2B shares the B+ layout, so every value is from the B+ drawing and marked unverified.
The far edge (GPIO header) has no ports, so the lid's tuck flap goes inside the far wall.
Camera and display ribbon connectors are not given openings; route ribbons out under the lid.
